name: Two-Option Criteria Split
description: A balanced present-time comparison of two alternatives under shared visible criteria.
composition_guidance: Place two equivalent present-time alternatives across a central divide with equal visual weight and shared visible criteria. Reserve one upper title band for the complete intended episode title rendered directly by the selected image model. The active Visual Style remains the final authority for medium, palette, texture, lighting, and rendering technique.
composition_rules: Show exactly two contemporaneous alternatives at equal visual weight.
Use a central divide that preserves one comparison reading path.
Make the shared criteria visible without dense labels.
Keep one upper title band clear and neutral.
required_elements: One upper title band with the model-rendered complete episode title
avoid_elements: A preselected winner, universal recommendation, or unsupported ranking
Hidden criteria, tiny labels, copied trade dress, logos, watermarks, or post-render typography compositing
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended episode title directly in the upper title band. Use one, two, or three balanced lines according to title length, preserving equal option weight and small-screen readability.
visual_style_guidance: The recipe controls equal-weight two-option comparison, shared criteria, and the upper title band. The active Visual Style remains authoritative for all rendering choices.
